readings.moment: Girard heard the temple strike ten while sitting alone in the dining room after dinner
Girard went out into the street to smoke
the piano started up in the salon just as Girard lit his cigar

Girard came back into the house
the hall clock had just struck eleven when Girard came back in
the face of the hall clock showed two minutes past eleven when Girard came back in
